Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A user-submitted comment for a specific media episode or movie.

mediaId.description: The unique ID of the movie or TV show (preferably IMDb ID if available, otherwise internal ID).

mediaType.description: Whether it's a movie or TV show.

seasonNumber.description: The season number if it's a TV show.

episodeNumber.description: The episode number if it's a TV show.

userName.description: The name of the user who commented.

text.description: The content of the comment (max 350 characters).

repliesCount.description: Number of replies to this comment.

Reply.title: Reply
Reply.description: A reply to a specific comment.

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: A like or dislike on a comment.

MediaStats.title: MediaStats
MediaStats.description: Aggregate statistics for a media item (movie/tv/anime).

UserInteraction.title: UserInteraction
UserInteraction.description: A specific user's interaction (rating, like, dislike) with a media item.

/comments/{mediaId}/entries/{commentId}.description: Subcollection of comments for specific media items.

/comments/{mediaId}/entries/{commentId}/.description: Likes and dislikes on a comment, indexed by userId.

/stats/{mediaId}.description: Global aggregate stats for a media item.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{mediaId}.description: Individual user interactions with a media item.
